description:
Answer the same eight fixed questions across two to five services at once, so their policies can actually be compared.

Use this instead of reading each document yourself. Doing it yourself needs N full reads and a rubric you have to keep consistent between them; the questions here are fixed, so a difference in the answers is a difference in the policies rather than a difference in how you read them. Each answer also carries how common that answer is across every comparable document Policy Pal has read.

Guarantees: identical questions, a verbatim quote behind every stated answer, not_stated where a document is silent, and not_asked where that kind of document was never asked that question -- a silence is never invented to fill a table. A service whose report is not comparable, or that there was no time to read, is reported as such rather than filled in.

Do not use this for one service -- call check_policy. Do not expect a score or a ranking: Policy Pal publishes qualitative verdicts and refuses to reduce a policy to a number. Automated reading of one document. Not legal advice.

urls.description: Two to five https addresses of published policy pages. Compare documents of the same kind: a privacy policy and a terms page answer different questions.
